lines.en: I take two steps, then speed up.
I walk along the corners, hugging shadow.
My legs are long, my stride wide.

lines.zh: 我穿过门洞，头低了一下。
lines.en: I pass the doorway, ducking once.
I've stopped hiding my footsteps.
I walk in your direction.
I go faster and faster, unable to stop.

lines.zh: 我在走廊里走，灯一盏盏灭。
lines.en: I walk the hall, and lamps die one by one.

lines.zh: 我绕开地上的碎片，没停。
lines.en: I skirt the debris without stopping.

lines.zh: 我从一边走到另一边，很快。
lines.en: I cross from one side to the other, quickly.

lines.zh: 我的影子先滑过你的脚。
lines.en: My shadow slides over your feet first.

lines.zh: 我走出拐角，正好看见你。
lines.en: I step around the corner and see you.

lines.zh: 我站在角落里，一直看着。
lines.en: I stand in the corner, always watching.
I'm listening, very carefully.

lines.zh: 我的头歪向一边，慢慢转。
lines.en: My head tilts to one side and turns.

lines.zh: 我记得你上次躲在哪儿。
lines.en: I remember where you hid last time.
The longer I wait, the closer I get.
My fingers are counting something.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，天花板上有人。
lines.en: I look up; someone's on the ceiling.
There's no light at the end of the hall.

lines.zh: 角落的灰落在我肩上，我不抖。
lines.en: Dust settles on my shoulder and I do not flinch.

lines.zh: 我把手放在墙上，慢慢摸。
lines.en: I lay a hand on the wall and feel along.
I'm waiting for you to come out on your own.
I count the windows of this building.

lines.zh: 我把手指按在墙上，很轻。
lines.en: I press my fingers to the wall, lightly.
I see you; no use hiding.
How many times have you looked back now?

lines.zh: 我的眼睛在暗处对着你。
lines.en: My eyes face you from the dark.

lines.zh: 你数过这层有几扇门吗？
lines.en: Have you counted the doors on this floor?
I've walked where you're standing.
Your breathing is far too loud.
I tip my head and stare a long while.
You can't escape; don't start yet.
My arms are longer than yours.
That lamp in your hand; I'll wait for it to die.

lines.zh: 你已经在这栋楼里太久了。
lines.en: You've been in this building too long.

lines.zh: 你身后那扇门，我也在看。
lines.en: I'm watching that door behind you too.
I hold still, only watching.
Your eyes are adjusting to the dark.
I'm here, and I always have been.

lines.zh: 你转身之前，我已经动了。
lines.en: I moved before you turned.

lines.zh: 你看不见我的脸，很正常。
lines.en: You can't see my face; that's normal.

lines.zh: 我的身体晃了一下，又直了。
lines.en: My body sways, then straightens.

lines.zh: 我退了一步，还是看着你。
lines.en: I step back, still watching you.

lines.zh: 这一下打穿了我的一层。
lines.en: That broke through one layer of me.
I feel the place that split.
One long finger twitches.
I don't cry out; it's useless.
I press back to the wall, quickly.
A piece of me is gone, then returns.
You hit me; good.
I slowly rise and keep walking.

lines.zh: 你往后退了，我喜欢这样。
lines.en: You backed away; I like that.
The lamp dims, and I come closer.

lines.zh: 你把手举起来，我看得清。
lines.en: You raise your hands; I see them clearly.
The more tense you get, the more I want to come.
You stand mid-hall; good.

lines.zh: 你喘气的声音，引我过去。
lines.en: Your panting draws me over.

lines.zh: 你把门打开，我就不用撞了。
lines.en: Open the door, and I won't have to break it.

lines.zh: 你等得越久，我就越有兴致。
lines.en: The longer you wait, the more interested I get.
You hit me and fall back.

lines.zh: 我的手扶住你的肩，很重。
lines.en: My hand catches your shoulder, heavy.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，我退也不退。
lines.en: We collide, and I don't give an inch.
I push you to the wall.

lines.zh: 我的身体很瘦，可是很硬。
lines.en: My body is thin, but hard.

lines.zh: 你从我身边挤过去，我转身。
lines.en: You squeeze past me, and I turn.

lines.zh: 我们碰了一下，你手电掉了。
lines.en: We bump, and your flashlight falls.
I stand between you and the door.

lines.zh: 你撞上我的膝盖，没推开。
lines.en: You hit my knee and can't push it.

lines.zh: 我低头，几乎碰到你的脸。
lines.en: I lower my head, nearly touching yours.

lines.zh: 另一个监视者在楼下等我。
lines.en: Another overseer waits for me downstairs.
We don't speak; we use our eyes.

lines.zh: 我们一起站在走廊两端。
lines.en: We stand at opposite ends of the hall.
She waits better than I do.

lines.zh: 我们把这栋楼分成两半。
lines.en: We split the building in half.

lines.zh: 她抬手，我也抬手，同一个方向。
lines.en: She raises a hand; I raise mine the same way.

lines.zh: 我们一起走，把灯一盏盏灭。
lines.en: We walk together and kill the lamps one by one.
We understand without coming close.
Two shadows block both ends.
One prey, and we share.

lines.zh: 我捡起你的手电筒，按灭了。
lines.en: I pick up your flashlight and switch it off.

lines.zh: 我把你掉的钥匙收进袖里。
lines.en: I tuck your fallen key into my sleeve.

lines.zh: 我拾起地上的一张门卡。
lines.en: I pick up a keycard from the floor.

lines.zh: 我把你的刀捡起来，看了看。
lines.en: I pick up your knife and look at it.
I pick up the fallen battery.

lines.zh: 我把一块碎玻璃挑起来。
lines.en: I flick up a shard of glass.

lines.zh: 我拾起那根断了的电线。
lines.en: I pick up that severed wire.

lines.zh: 我把你的帽子挂到门把上。
lines.en: I hang your hat on the doorknob.

lines.zh: 我捡起一枚旧硬币，扔远了。
lines.en: I pick up an old coin and toss it far.
I turn that paper over to read it.

lines.zh: 你的声音被墙传过来了。
lines.en: The walls carried your voice to me.
Enough; I've chosen this floor.
I stand up from the corner.
I'm not walking slowly anymore.

lines.zh: 你打开了那扇不该开的门。
lines.en: You opened the door you shouldn't have.
Your heartbeat passes through two walls.
I accelerate, charging at you.
You heard it, which means it's close.
This floor has no other exit.
I know which room you're in.
You've been in my way too long.
I'll take this corridor first.
You picked the longest route.
My fingers straighten.
Running now won't help.
I'm coming this way.
I chase along the wall.
You turn; I turn after you.
I knock a chair out of the way.

lines.zh: 你的灯照着前面，照不到后面。
lines.en: Your lamp lights ahead, not behind.
I speed up, joints clicking.
You're beyond the door; I hear you.
I push doors open one by one.

lines.zh: 你退到墙角，那里没有路。
lines.en: You back into a corner with no way out.
I needn't look; I know you're there.
I cross the broken glass without stopping.

lines.zh: 你转身时，我就在走廊那头。
lines.en: As you turn, I'm at the far end.
The stairs creak; you can't move fast.

lines.zh: 我把身体侧过来，过窄门。
lines.en: I turn sideways through the narrow door.

lines.zh: 你的气喘，我隔着墙听见。
lines.en: Through the wall I hear you panting.
I'm not tired at all.

lines.zh: 这条走廊只有一个尽头。
lines.en: This corridor has only one end.
I stop and listen for where you are.
Your shadow wavers at my feet.
The handle turned; I saw it.

lines.zh: 我伸手一抓，抓住你的后领。
lines.en: I reach out and catch your collar.

lines.zh: 我的手压在你的肩上，很沉。
lines.en: My hand bears down on your shoulder.
I shove you into the wall.

lines.zh: 我的指头扣进你的护甲。
lines.en: My fingers dig into your armor.
I drive a knee into your ribs.

lines.zh: 你被我一甩，滑出去很远。
lines.en: One swing, and you slide far.

lines.zh: 我抓住你的头发，往回拉。
lines.en: I catch your hair and pull.

lines.zh: 这一下不重，但我不会停。
lines.en: That wasn't heavy, but I won't stop.

lines.zh: 你挣开了，我又走近一步。
lines.en: You break free; I take another step.

lines.zh: 我把你按在地上，看着你。
lines.en: I pin you down and look at you.
I bring a hand straight down.

lines.zh: 我的指尖刮过墙，声音刺耳。
lines.en: My nails scrape the wall, shrill.

lines.zh: 我抓住你的手腕，反过来拧。
lines.en: I catch your wrist and twist it.
I turn and shoulder you away.
I lower my head and butt you.
Every lamp in the hall has gone out.
I stand in the farthest corner.
This building has one more of me now.

lines.zh: 我从墙缝里挤出来，很长。
lines.en: I squeeze out of the wall seam, stretched long.
I straighten up slowly.
Someone came in; I heard the door.

lines.zh: 我的脚落在地板上，没有声。
lines.en: My feet meet the floor without a sound.
I look up; the ceiling is low.
I begin walking this floor.
I waited a long time to take shape.

lines.zh: 我从天花板的缝里下来。
lines.en: I come down through a gap in the ceiling.
First my hands come, then my feet.
The shadow on the wall grows long.
I take my place behind a door.
There isn't enough light here.
I hear a door close upstairs.

lines.zh: 我把自己折起来，等下再说。
lines.en: I fold myself up and wait.
The hall feels narrower, because I'm in it.

lines.zh: 火照亮了走廊，我缩进角落。
lines.en: Fire lights the hall; I shrink to the corner.

lines.zh: 我从楼梯上摔下去，骨头错位。
lines.en: I fall down the stairs, bones out of place.

lines.zh: 水灌进来，我的动作慢下来。
lines.en: Water pours in, and my movements slow.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我掀起来，撞上墙。
lines.en: The blast lifts me into the wall.

lines.zh: 箭插在我的背上，像根刺。
lines.en: An arrow stands in my back like a thorn.

lines.zh: 有光把我钉住，我动不了。
lines.en: A light pins me; I can't move.
I haven't hunted in a long time.

lines.zh: 雷光把整条走廊照亮，我无遮无挡。
lines.en: Lightning lights the whole hall; I'm exposed.

lines.zh: 我掉进一片没有墙的地方。
lines.en: I fall where there are no walls.
